# Gemini Media Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source build (MIT) by @bluman1, listed here with credit to its creator. A Muse agent skill that generates images (Nano Banana, Imagen 4), video (Veo) and speech (TTS) through Google's Gemini API with one key. Honest note: media generation requires a billing-enabled Google Cloud project — free-tier media quota is 0, so calls without billing fail — and every generation is billed (e.g. Veo 3 ~$0.40/sec, Imagen 4 ~$0.02–0.06/image). The skill confirms the model and expected cost with you before every generation. No secrets in the repo — API key stays in Muse's secure vault.
